digest.component_or_area: CLI parser construction and command routing
propositions: Inline argparse construction and manual dispatch in advanced command handlers must be replaced with reusable S2a parser factories
Parser factories must remain lean and import-free of optional runtimes (Pydantic AI, FastAPI, Jira transport, workflow executors, metrics, tracing)

Parse failures must be caught uniformly: RebarArgumentParser raises ParseError instead of SystemExit(2), requiring migration of existing exception handlers to preserve identical exit codes and stderr bytes
Commands with custom presentation (usage=, RawDescriptionHelpFormatter, add_help=False) must preserve byte-identical --help output via optional factory keyword arguments
All registered advanced routes must have factory references and be deterministically generation-ready without importing heavy optional modules or executing handlers
